description: Look through a connected drive and propose contract bundles from FILE AND FOLDER NAMES: which file is the contract, which are annexes, amendments, terminations and handover protocols, and which belong together. Required: root_id — roots[].id from list_file_accounts (the provider drive id works too). Optional: folder_id, query, limit (default 200), min_confidence (default 0.5). Reads names only — no file is downloaded, nothing is written. Every bundle carries the reason it was grouped and a confidence; below 0.5 it is a finding to look at, not a proposal to accept. Use import_contract_group to take one over.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

min_confidence.description: Minimum grouping confidence for proposed bundles, 0..1 (default 0.5)

name: scan_contract_files
